controlsEnforced.shortcutThreat: Resolution Asymmetry (e.g. Model detecting whether an image is 512x512 vs native COCO dimension)
controlsEnforced.mechanism: Resolution-Matched Pairing: In every sampled pair, authentic and edited samples share identical resolution buckets (native, 512, or 1024).

controlsEnforced.shortcutThreat: Preprocessing Pipeline Discrepancy (e.g. Applying different resizing, interpolation, or normalization to authentic vs edited classes)
controlsEnforced.mechanism: Symmetric Preprocessing Contract: Both classes pass through the identical bicubic interpolation and ImageNet tensor normalization pipeline.

controlsEnforced.shortcutThreat: Variant Over-Representation / Pseudoreplication (e.g. edited variants dominating training batches 6:1 over authentic)
controlsEnforced.mechanism: Pair-Aware Equal Contribution: Exactly 1 authentic and 1 edited sample per unique source_id per epoch (strict 1:1 balance, 2N samples/epoch).

controlsEnforced.shortcutThreat: Resolution Bias over Training (e.g. over-exposing native vs 512 vs 1024)
controlsEnforced.mechanism: Balanced Resolution Cycling: All 3 resolution buckets cycle evenly across epochs (1:1:1 ratio over 3 epochs).

controlsEnforced.shortcutThreat: Edit-Type Bias over Training (e.g. over-exposing bbox vs segm inpainting masks)
controlsEnforced.mechanism: Balanced Edit Type Cycling: Both bbox and segm inpainting masks cycle evenly across epochs (1:1 ratio over 6 epochs).
SHA-256 64-bit Integer Offset: Independent of PYTHONHASHSEED.
Split Isolation Guard: Zero source_id overlap between development_train, inner_validation, and locked_test.
